description: Documentation and API overview for the Drupal Package Manager module, including stage lifecycle, events, exceptions, validators, and services.

classes.name: StageBase
classes.description: Abstract class controlling the stage lifecycle and operations in the Package Manager module.

classes.name: StageEvent
classes.description: Base class for all stage-related events dispatched during the stage lifecycle.

classes.name: PreOperationStageEvent
classes.description: Base class for pre-operation stage events, extending StageEvent.

classes.name: PreCreateEvent
classes.description: Event dispatched before creating a stage directory.

classes.name: PostCreateEvent
classes.description: Event dispatched after creating a stage directory.

classes.name: PreRequireEvent
classes.description: Event dispatched before requiring packages into the stage.

classes.name: PostRequireEvent
classes.description: Event dispatched after requiring packages into the stage.

classes.name: PreApplyEvent
classes.description: Event dispatched before applying stage changes to the active directory.

classes.name: PostApplyEvent
classes.description: Event dispatched after applying stage changes to the active directory.

classes.name: ValidationResult
classes.description: Represents validation results, errors, and warnings during stage operations.

classes.name: FailureMarker
classes.description: Service managing the PACKAGE_MANAGER_FAILURE.yml file indicating failed stage application.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates the stage directory, records ownership, and dispatches related events.

methods.name: require
methods.description: Adds or updates packages in the stage directory.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Copies changes from the stage directory into the active directory.

methods.name: postApply
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks after applying stage changes, including cache clearing and event dispatch.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the stage directory and releases ownership.

methods.name: stageDirectoryExists
methods.description: Checks if the stage directory exists.

methods.name: getStageDirectory
methods.description: Returns the absolute path of the stage directory.

methods.name: isApplying
methods.description: Checks if the stage is currently applying changes.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a stage directory can be created.
